title: Shapes: How Orchard Core Renders a Page | Orchard Core
description:
Every page of an Orchard Core site is built from shapes, but it is not always clear which object, binding or template produced a fragment of markup.

This video explains the shape: the data and metadata it holds, how you create and render one from Razor, Liquid and C#, how Orchard Core resolves a binding and a template, how layouts, zones and display drivers produce shapes, and how to see which template rendered a fragment.

In this video:
• What a shape is
• A page made of shapes
• Create and render a shape
• The shape contract
• How a shape renders
• Templates and code bindings
• Layouts and zones
• Shapes from display drivers
• Find the template of a shape
